% Generated by paper/scripts/make_rgb_policy_baselines_compact.py; edit that script instead.
% Palette from the approved rgb-policy figure family; colors encode asset splits.
\newcommand{\seenColor}{0.004 0.514 0.733}
\newcommand{\unseenColor}{1.000 0.859 0.820}
\newcommand{\colorpush}[1]{\special{color push rgb #1}}
\newcommand{\colorpop}{\special{color pop}}
% One stacked bar: x, baseline y, split y, top y, seen height, unseen height, total height, top label.
\newcommand{\stackbar}[8]{%
  \put(#1,#2){\colorpush{\seenColor}\rule{0.19in}{#5in}\colorpop}%
  \put(#1,#3){\colorpush{\unseenColor}\rule{0.19in}{#6in}\colorpop}%
  \put(#1,#3){\line(1,0){0.19}}%
  \put(#1,#2){\framebox(0.19,#7){}}%
  \put(#1,#4){\makebox(0.19,0)[b]{\raisebox{2pt}{\footnotesize #8}}}%
}
